declaration.preface:
At Novopor, we believe that a strong commitment to labor and human rights is fundamental to our mission of enabling sustainable innovation and creating a positive impact on society. We recognize our responsibility to uphold the highest ethical standards in our workplaces and throughout our supply chain. We are dedicated to fostering a work environment that promotes fairness, safety, inclusivity, and dignity for all employees, contractors, and stakeholders.

Our labor and human rights policy serves as a cornerstone of our corporate social responsibility efforts, ensuring that our operations align with international labor laws and human rights frameworks. By prioritizing ethical working conditions, employee well-being, diversity, equity, inclusion, and career development, we strive to empower our workforce and create a culture of mutual respect and integrity.
declaration.declaration: Novopor is committed to foster an inclusive, ethical, and fair work environment by upholding the highest standards of labor and human rights across all our operation. Our commitment is reflected in the following key areas:
declaration.scope: This Labor and Human Rights Policy applies to all employees, contractors, suppliers, business partners, and stakeholders associated with Novopor Operations. It is applicable to all site locations:

focusAreas: Prevention of Child Labor, Forced Labor & Human Trafficking
Freedom of Association and Whistleblower Protection
Compliance with Labor Laws and Standards

Fair and Ethical Working Conditions: We are committed to ensuring that all employees receive fair wages, work in just conditions, and are treated with dignity and respect. We uphold fair labor practices by complying with wage laws, conducting regular wage reviews, and fostering an environment free from discrimination and exploitation.
All employees, suppliers, and leadership teams undergo mandatory training on fair working conditions, DEI and child and forced labor and human trafficking prevention.
Health, Safety & Well-being: Employee health and safety are paramount at Novopor. We invest in comprehensive safety programs, conduct regular workplace hazard assessments, and provide ongoing training to mitigate risks. Our facilities comply with international occupational health and safety standards, and we offer health benefits, wellness initiatives, and mental health support to create a safe and supportive work environment.
Regular health and safety audits are conducted across all facilities to identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a safe working environment for all employees.
Prevention of Discrimination, Harassment: Novopor is committed to maintaining a respectful and inclusive workplace free from all forms of discrimination, harassment, and abuse—whether physical, psychological, or verbal. We uphold a strict zero-tolerance approach toward any conduct that undermines the dignity, safety, or well-being of our employees. All individuals—whether full-time, part-time, temporary, or contractual—are entitled to equal treatment, fairness, and respect regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, gender identity or expression, or any other protected characteristic. To support this commitment, Novopor implements robust internal policies, provides regular training programs, ensures accessible and confidential grievance mechanisms, and guarantees timely and impartial resolution of any reported incidents.
Prevention of Child Labor, Forced Labor: We are committed to upholding human rights by ensuring that our operations and supply chain are free from child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking. We strictly prohibit the employment of individuals below the legal working age and reject any form of bonded, involuntary, or coerced labor. Through rigorous due diligence, supplier audits, and ethical recruitment practices, we ensure compliance with international labor laws and human rights standards.
Career Growth & Employee Development: We believe in empowering employees through career development and continuous learning. We provide structured training programs, mentorship opportunities, and internal promotion pathways to support professional growth. Our initiatives aim to equip employees with the skills needed to advance in their careers, ensuring long-term success and engagement within the company.
Skill development programs are implemented to provide continuous learning opportunities, ensuring all employees have access to career advancement initiatives.
Freedom of Association and Whistleblower: Novopor respects employees’ rights to freedom of association and collective bargaining. We provide a transparent and confidential whistleblower mechanism that allows employees to report concerns without fear of retaliation. We actively encourage open communication and ensure that all employees are aware of their rights to raise grievances and participate in labor unions or employee organizations.

Novopor respects employees' rights to form unions and negotiate collectively. Open dialogues between management and workers ensure transparency, and collective bargaining agreements receive full recognition.

Employees and stakeholders access secure, anonymous grievance channels. An independent committee investigates concerns, ensuring fair resolutions and retaliation against whistleblowers is strictly prohibited.
External Stakeholders Rights: Novopor is committed to respecting and upholding the rights of external stakeholders, including suppliers, customers, communities, and business partners. We ensure fair, transparent, and ethical business practices, promoting open communication, non-discriminatory engagement, and responsible sourcing.
Compliance with Labor Laws and Standards: We fully comply with all national and international labor laws and local labor regulations. We continuously seek third-party certifications and independent audits to ensure alignment with global labor rights standards.

policy.monitoring:
Regular internal audits are conducted to assess compliance with labor laws, workplace safety, DEI initiatives, and employee welfare.

Key performance indicators (KPIs) such as workplace safety incidents, training hours, employee satisfaction, and diversity metrics are tracked.

Employees have access to anonymous reporting channels for workplace concerns related to discrimination, unfair labor practices, or unsafe working conditions.

Regular supplier audits ensure compliance with labor rights, ethical sourcing, and fair employment practices across the supply chain.

Secure whistleblower channels safeguard employees and stakeholders who report unethical labor practices, with strict non-retaliation policies and independent oversight committees handling cases.

The Policy is publicly available on Novopor’s website and shared through various stakeholder communication channels.

Employees are kept informed of updates and expected to integrate these practices into their work.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Human Resource Manager is responsible for managing the implementation and periodic review of this policy. To ensure its effectiveness and continued relevance, the policy will be reviewed annually. Any necessary updates or revisions will be communicated to all stakeholders, incorporating operational or regulatory changes and addressing emerging challenges.
